messages:
mira: Hey team — quick sync: planning to roll out the new 'cohort_liveness' flag that nudges routing away from low-health pools. Want to gate it behind telemetry so we can auto-pause if error-rate or latency spikes. Thoughts?
aj: +1 on gating. main q: what signals do we consider authoritative? 5xx, p95, and token drop?
ryan: I'd include average queue_time and backend_retries. Our last rollout only looked at 5xx and we missed increased tail latency.
leah: Agree. Also add a rolling sample of route-by-route success rate. We should avoid global rollbacks if just one tenant sees flakiness.
mira: Good points. Proposal: evaluate per-cohort p95 latency, 5xx rate, and queue_time. If any exceed thresholds for 2 consecutive windows (1m windows), config-bot pauses rollout for that cohort.
aj: Can config-bot also annotate the console with a highlighted SLI that tripped the pause? Makes ops faster.
leah: UI ask: show the sampled tenant list and a quick link to traces for the offending cohort.
config-bot: auto-note: "staging->prod rollout for cohort_liveness started by mira at 1761234570" :robot_face:
sam: Implementation detail: telemetry tag must include rollout_id so we can attribute metrics to this change. Without that, metric noise is hard to filter.
ryan: +1. Also we should emit a debug event when the flag decision path chooses fallback routing. That lets us replay.
mira: draft of the decision payload we can emit:```json
{
  "rollout_id": "r-1761234570",
  "cohort_id": "hash:0xabc",
  "decision": "reroute_to_high_health",
  "metrics": {"p95_ms": 220, "5xx": 0.012, "queue_ms": 35}
}```
aj: That looks good. Make sure we keep the payload size tiny — we're logging many of these. Maybe sample 1% for high-volume cohorts.
leah: Sampling policy should be configurable per-rollout. Default to 0.1% global, 1% for cohorts flagged as risky.
mira: Ops playbook question: who manually overrides a pause? Should be limited to oncall+owner. We should require an audit note in the console to unpause.
sam: Agree — add an "unpause_reason" field and record user_id, timestamp. Console will surface it.
ryan: Edge case: what if the telemetry backend itself has outages and falsely reports spikes? We should implement a fallback: if telemetry is not responding, treat it as "soft hold" — don't unpause further cohorts but keep existing cohorts running.
leah: For dashboards, add a compact "rollout health" sparkline per cohort with the three signals. Helps SRE spot noisy rollouts.
aj: API detail: the rollout controller should expose a preview endpoint: `GET /rollouts/:id/preview?cohort=hash:0xabc` that returns simulated decisions (no side effects). Useful for QA.
mira: Action items: 1) sam - add rollout_id to emitted metrics + small schema (due EOD). 2) ryan - add debug event for decision path (PR by tomorrow). 3) leah - sketch console UI for cohort sparkline & unpause modal (sync Thurs). 4) aj - validate sampling defaults and make them tunable.
leah: will wire mockup into the gauntlet tests so we can validate visibility.
aj: will also add a quick lint that flags any rollout without a sampling config.
config-bot: note: "action items recorded: sam, ryan, leah, aj" :white_check_mark:
mira: Thanks all. If we can get the metrics schema and preview endpoint proto this week, we can start a small canary next week. :thumbsup:
